description: Get the x402 payment quote for a paid query WITHOUT paying — returns the price, accepted payment details, and available pack tiers. No wallet required. Use this to see the exact cost before calling query_records.

filters.description: Product-specific query filters, e.g. { category: 'trading' } or { mbti_label: 'INTJ' }. See each product's allowed parameters in list_products.

limit.description: Optional max number of records to return

tier.description: Optional pack tier slug (e.g. 'pack-5k') for a bulk single-call result; omit for base per-query pricing

name: get_quote
title: Get price quote (free)
